Bill.BriefDescription: Adding transparency to elections through the installation of web camera surveillance systems.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to adding transparency to elections through theinstallation of web camera surveillance systems; adding a new sectionto chapter 29A.60 RCW; and creating a new section.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The legislature recognizes that citizensdemand integrity and transparency in elections. Therefore, thelegislature intends to provide better transparency in elections byusing technology to allow for monitoring of ballot processing duringelections.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 29A.60 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) County auditors are required to install a web camerasurveillance system in counting centers. The web camera surveillancesystem must be streamed live to the county auditor's web page. Thesystem must have a date and time stamp feature and must be capable ofrecording fortyeight hours or more. The cameras must be installed asa fixed mount with no motion and in a way to provide the best viewpossible without compromising ballot secrecy. At a minimum, cameras p. 1 HB 2586must be placed in the following ballot processing locations in thecounting center: Sorting areas, duplication area, counting andtabulation areas, and the areas where unvoted and voted ballots arestored. (2) Cameras must be active twentyfour hours a day beginning withthe process of insertion of ballots in preparation for mailing tomilitary/overseas voters before a primary, an election, or specialelection and ending upon certification of the election or electionrecounts.
